what.text: This page follows refugees from the State of Palestine living in Yemen, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 378 Palestinian refugees in Yemen, 0.8% of all refugees from the State of Palestine.
Greece hosts the most Palestinian refugees in UNHCR's data, followed by Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for the State of Palestine, so it does not say why people left.
The main year of displacement in the data is 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 700 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6000, at the end of 1996, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Yemen.
These are year-end totals for Yemen only, reported to UNHCR.
